note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, June 1958 (statutory day Thursday 5 June 1958); there was no poll. All 16 divisions are taken from the returning officer's notice of result (T. F. W. Nelson, returning officer, Rural District Council Office, Larne, dated 6 June 1958; Belfast Telegraph, 9 June 1958, p. 10): eleven sole candidates were declared elected and in Ballynure, Eden, Glenarm South, Glencloy and Middle Division the retiring members were deemed re-elected. No party labels are printed; places of abode are not reproduced. Returned unopposed.
